# Worker Workspaces Checklist: Workers in their own herdr workspaces, each with its own Codex tab

**Purpose**: Review the requirements for per-worker workspaces, their names, the Codex tab name, close, the saved-machine path and old workers, before planning
**Created**: 2026-11-09
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `checklist` procedure based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Workspace name

- [ ] CHK001 Is "about 30 characters" for the task words stated as an exact limit, with where the cut happens? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK002 Is it stated which Markdown marks are removed from the first heading, and what counts as the first heading? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the fallback for the orchestrator part defined for both cases: no label, and `--machine` outside herdr? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK004 Is it stated whether characters in the heading that a herdr label cannot hold are removed or replaced? [Gap, Spec §FR-002]

## Codex tab name

- [ ] CHK005 Is it stated how the advisor tells a worker workspace from an orchestrator workspace? [Gap, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the orchestrator name rule stated as "unchanged" with a scenario that proves it? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, §US2 Scenario 3]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the case of an orchestrator workspace label that looks like a worker name covered? [Edge Case, Gap]

## Close

- [ ] CHK008 Is the rule for "whole workspace or tab only" stated with the exact set of tabs that may be in the workspace? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK009 Is it stated that `close` never closes the workspace that runs it, for local and saved machine? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK010 Do the existing refusals of `close` all still hold, by name? [Consistency, Spec §US3 Scenario 2]

## Saved machine

- [ ] CHK011 Is the orchestrator part of the name on a saved machine taken from the local workspace, not the remote one? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK012 Is cleanup after a failed workspace create stated for a saved machine as well? [Coverage, Spec §FR-008]

## Old workers and scope

- [ ] CHK013 Are workers started before this feature (tabs in the orchestrator's workspace) covered for every command? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, §US3 Scenario 3]
- [ ] CHK014 Is it clear which commands this feature does not change, to keep the #93 overlap small? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
